target.statement: Wan-Weaver achieves Overall 8.43 on WeaverBench for interleaved text-image generation

compute.basis: The target requires the paper's full Wan-Weaver model: a 32B-class in-house planner plus a from-scratch DiT visualizer trained for 9.6T tokens and planner-tuned for 35.72G tokens, with no released code or checkpoints.

blockers: No code, configs, or checkpoints are linked in the paper
Planner is initialized from an in-house Qwen2.5-VL-32B-Think model, not a public checkpoint
Visualizer is trained from scratch on 9.6T tokens with a large multi-stage data pipeline
Planner tuning uses 35.72G tokens of synthesized/proprietary textual-proxy data and large understanding data
WeaverBench prompts and evaluation protocol are not released/linked
Evaluation relies on GPT-4o-as-judge and large-scale model generation, requiring a multi-GPU cluster
Laptop/CPU-only reproduction of the 32B planner plus DiT visualizer is not feasible
title: Wan-Weaver: Interleaved Multi-modal Generation via Decoupled Training
